drail.definition: v. t. & i. To trail; to draggle.

drain.definition:
n. emptying something accomplished by allowing liquid to run out of it
n. tube inserted into a body cavity (as during surgery) to remove unwanted material
n. a pipe through which liquid is carried away
n. a gradual depletion of energy or resources
drain.translation:
n. 排水沟, 消耗, 排水
vt. 排出, 喝光, 耗尽
vi. 排水, 流干

drain cock.translation: [化] 排液旋塞; 放水旋塞; 排水栓

drain connection.translation: [化] 排液口; 排污接管; 排液接管

drain cup.translation: [化] 排液漏斗; 排水漏斗

drain line.translation: [化] 排水管道; 泄水管

drain message.translation: [计] 遗漏信息, 遗漏报文

drain outlet.translation: [化] 排污管; 排污口; 排水出口; 排泄口; 排液口

drain-holes.translation: (drain-hole 的复数) 排泄孔；排水孔

drainage.definition: n emptying something accomplished by allowing liquid to run out of it
drainage.translation:
n. 排水
[医] 引流[法], 导液[法], 排水[设备]

drainage area.translation: 流域; 流泄区; 电泄面积

drainage hopper.translation: [化] 排液漏斗; 排水漏斗

drainage-basin.translation: （美）（河流的）[水文] 流域；流域盆地

drainage-basins.translation: (drainage-basin 的复数) （美）（河流的）[水文] 流域；流域盆地

drainages.definition:
plural of drainage
n emptying something accomplished by allowing liquid to run out of it
drainages.translation:
(drainage 的复数) n. 排水
[医] 引流[法], 导液[法], 排水[设备]

drainboard.definition: n. a board beside a kitchen sink and inclined to drain into the sink

drained.definition: a. emptied or exhausted of (as by drawing off e.g. water or other liquid)
drained.translation: v. （使）流干, （使）逐渐流走( drain的过去式和过去分词 ); 喝光, 喝干; 使（精力、金钱等）耗尽

drainer.definition: n. One who, or that which, drains.
drainer.translation: n. 排水器, 下水道修建工, 排水工, 放泄器, 滴干板, 滤干器

drainers.definition:
plural of drainer
n. One who, or that which, drains.
drainers.translation: (drainer 的复数) n. 排水器, 下水道修建工, 排水工, 放泄器, 滴干板, 滤干器

drainless.translation: a. 无排水设备的, 取用不竭的

drainpipe.definition: n a pipe through which liquid is carried away

drainpipes.definition: n. a pipe through which liquid is carried away
drainpipes.translation: n. 排水管( drainpipe的复数形式 )

drainplug.translation:
un. 排水孔塞；放泄塞；放水塞；放油塞
[网络] 排水塞

drains.definition:
n emptying something accomplished by allowing liquid to run out of it
n tube inserted into a body cavity (as during surgery) to remove unwanted material
n a pipe through which liquid is carried away
n a gradual depletion of energy or resources
v flow off gradually

v empty of liquid; drain the liquid from

drains.translation:
n. 消耗( drain的名词复数 ); 排水沟; 下水道孔盖; 流尽
v. （使）流干, （使）逐渐流走( drain的第三人称单数 ); 喝光, 喝干; 使（精力、金钱等）耗尽

drains on cash.translation: [经] 现金消耗, 现金外流汇票
